name: zero-to-hero
description: Convert product ideas, prototypes, or messy repos into clean, canonical, implementation-ready repositories for Codex/OMX.

interface.shortDescription: Turn ideas or messy repos into implementation-ready product repos.
interface.longDescription: Runs deep interview, research, canonical source-of-truth docs, UI/design/hardware packs, frontend parity, product usability, local-product harnesses, repo-scoped skills, OMX handoff, and lossless cleanup. It does not implement product runtime code.
defaultPrompt: Use zero-to-hero to turn this idea or repo into a clean, canonical, implementation-ready Codex/OMX handoff repo. Start with the deep interview. Do not implement product runtime code.
